text.en:
Amendment of section 90 of S 48/06.

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE

OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM under Article 83(31) !AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2006 In exercise of the power conferred by Clause (3) of Article 83 of the of Brunei Darussalam, His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan hereby makes the following Orderand commencement. l. This Order may be cited as the Insurance (Amendment) Order, 2006 and shall be deemed to have commenced on the same date as the Insurance Order, 2006 (S 48/06). of section 90 of S 48/06.
